questions.question_text: Order the steps to create an internal Load Balancer with a health probe.

question_data.instructions: Place the items in the correct order.

options.label: A
options.text: Create a virtual network and backend subnet

options.label: B
options.text: Create the internal Load Balancer with frontend IP

options.label: C
options.text: Add backend pool and health probe

questions.explanation: Networking and backend subnet come first, then the load balancer, backend pool/probe, and finally the load balancing rule.
